name: Pastel-Hoopes
description: Pastel Hoopes: A lightweight online shop for Pastel Hoopes, a small hair-accessories Hustle. Built so customers can browse products, play Spin & Win / Scratch & Win for discounts, and place orders directly on WhatsApp — without a heavy e-commerce system. Made for the brand’s own use during RevHack Hackathon

paragraphs: Pastel Hoopes is a small Indian brand that sells soft, pretty hair accessories — claw clips, hair clips, scrunchies, mini clips, and curated hampers. This repository contains the complete online storefront built for the business: a lightweight, fast, mobile-friendly shop where customers can browse products, play Spin & Win / Scratch & Win, apply coupons, and place orders via WhatsApp.
So we built a pure front-end shop that feels polished but stays easy to maintain.
features: Looks soft and on-brand (pastel pinks, clean product photography)
Lets customers discover products and play small games for discounts
Sends orders straight to WhatsApp (no complicated checkout)
